blocks.text: The following example shows how to look up categories in ZIA for a specified list of URLs using /urlLookup.

blocks.item: In the workspace where you added your collection, go to Collections.
Click the OneAPI folder and then click the Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) folder.
Go to URL categories > POST URL Lookup. The /urlLookup request appears on the right-side pane.

blocks.text: Click the request's Body tab to view the list of reconfigured URLs for which the lookup operation must be performed. You can look up a maximum of 100 URLs per request, with each URL not exceeding 1,024 characters.
When the request is successful, you receive a Status 200 OK message and a response body.
